preconditions.description: The number of integers N must be between 3 and 1000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= B[i][j] <= 5000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix B must be between 0 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N for p in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query index p must be a valid row/column index between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= F[i] <= 5000 for i in range(N) for F in query_values)
preconditions.description: All new values F in the queries must be between 0 and 5000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest sequence A after each query.
Each output line must contain exactly N integers.

postconditions.expression: all(A[i] == 0 for i in range(N) if i == 0)
postconditions.description: The first element of the sequence A must always be 0.
